study: Reviewer-triggered stronger-baseline reanalysis of inspected original confirmation counts
scope: Retrospective diagnostic, not a fresh confirmatory test. All original 400 primary trials retained.
observational_allocation: Within alpha_O: half to d two-sided conditional intervals, half to 2d one-sided joint-event lower intervals. Frozen before this reanalysis.
fusion_allocation: Half to each source; all standalone sources receive full alpha independently. No data-dependent selection among views is authorized.
analyses: mean lower bound and SD with deterministic fallback on no-bound
extra certification over all three separately full-alpha baselines as a comparison only
significance_tests: None: method adapted after inspection. Describe all four conditions without new confirmatory p-values.
stopping_rule: Exactly the 400 existing trials once after implementation review; preserve all outcomes and source snapshot. No outcome-dependent exclusions.
independence_scope: iid simulation events; fixed worlds and declared source conditions from original registration. Does not establish practical transport validity.
